algs.name: GOFEE (Gaussian-process surrogate search)
desc: GOFEE trains a Gaussian-process surrogate (double-Gaussian kernel on a radial + angular distribution fingerprint, repulsive prior) on every NEP energy obtained so far. Each iteration it generates 30 candidates from a population of 10 low-energy structures (random structures, rattle, cut-and-splice, permutation), relaxes them for free in the surrogate's lower confidence bound mu - 2 sigma, and spends real ionic steps only on the most promising one (one single point plus one force-driven 'dual point'). This is the standard published method (Bisbo & Hammer); the only additions are an occasional short true NEP relaxation of the best unrelaxed population member, needed because a hit requires an energy within 0.02 eV of a true NEP minimum, and caps on the training set and surrogate steps to bound the wall time.

GOFEE 用迄今得到的所有 NEP 能量训练一个高斯过程代理模型（基于径向+角度分布指纹的双高斯核，并带排斥先验）。每次迭代从 10 个低能结构组成的种群中生成 30 个候选结构（随机结构、扰动、切割拼接、元素置换），在代理模型的置信下界 mu - 2 sigma 上免费弛豫，只对最有希望的一个结构花费真实离子步（一次单点计算加一个沿受力方向的“对偶点”）。这是 Bisbo 与 Hammer 发表的标准方法；唯一的补充是偶尔对种群中能量最低且尚未弛豫的结构做一次简短的真实 NEP 弛豫（因为命中要求能量在真实 NEP 极小值 0.02 eV 以内），以及为控制墙钟时间而对训练集大小和代理弛豫步数设的上限。
algs.ref: M. K. Bisbo and B. Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 086102 (2020); M. K. Bisbo and B. Hammer, Phys. Rev. B 105, 245404 (2022)

algs.name: Online-surrogate pre-relaxation BH
desc: Basin hopping in which a cheap surrogate potential (a linear moment-tensor/MEAM-like model of per-atom energies, frozen host atoms included as neighbours) is refitted on the fly by ridge regression to the energies, forces and virials of every NEP step of the run itself - no pretrained data. Each cycle relaxes a batch of candidate moves (perturbations, relocations, crossover, swaps, random structures) on the surrogate for free, discards those that fall back into already visited basins (fingerprints) or into model holes, and spends NEP steps only on the lowest predicted new minimum. New: the NEP relaxation itself is surrogate-Newton - every ionic step jumps to the trust-region minimum of the surrogate corrected to the current NEP energy and forces (cell included for bulk), so a minimum costs a few ionic steps instead of tens; the screening step size is tuned to the surrogate basin-escape rate, and the method falls back to unscreened moves when the online-measured surrogate error is large or a wall-time governor triggers.

在基跳(basin hopping)框架中在线拟合一个廉价的代理势(线性矩张量/类MEAM的原子能量模型，冻结的基底原子作为近邻参与描述)，用岭回归拟合本次运行中每一个NEP离子步的能量、力和维里，不使用任何预训练数据。每个循环先在代理势上免费弛豫一批候选结构(扰动、原子重定位、交叉、元素互换、随机结构)，用指纹剔除落回已访问能谷的候选以及落入模型“空洞”的候选，只把预测能量最低的新极小值交给NEP弛豫。创新点：NEP弛豫本身采用“代理牛顿”步——每个离子步都跳到经当前NEP能量和力校正后的代理势在信赖域内的极小点(体相同时优化晶胞)，因此每个极小值只需少量离子步而不是数十步；筛选步长按代理势上的逃逸能谷比例自适应，当在线测得的代理误差过大或墙钟时间调控器触发时，自动退回不经筛选的普通移动。
algs.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Shapeev, Multiscale Model. Simul. 14, 1153 (2016) [moment tensor potentials]; Baskes, Phys. Rev. B 46, 2727 (1992) [MEAM angular densities]; Jacobsen, Jorgensen & Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 026102 (2018) [on-the-fly learned structure search]; Kolsbjerg, Peterson & Hammer, Phys. Rev. B 97, 195424 (2018) [NN-accelerated global optimisation]; Podryabinkin, Tikhonov, Shapeev & Oganov, Phys. Rev. B 99, 064114 (2019) [MLIP pre-relaxation in crystal structure prediction]; del Rio, Mortensen & Jacobsen, Phys. Rev. B 100, 104103 (2019) [GPMin surrogate-accelerated local optimisation]; Bisbo & Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 086102 (2020) [GOFEE, contrasted]

algs.name: Adaptive memetic algorithm (GA + BH chains)
desc: A small niched population of relaxed structures (seeded with only two random structures and filled by offspring) is evolved by three competing operators: Deaven-Ho cut-and-splice (registry-preserving on surfaces) or lattice heredity (bulk), short self-terminating Metropolis basin-hopping chains started from good, not yet exhausted members, and new random structures, half of which are grown atom by atom at well-bonded sites. The ionic-step budget is shared among the operators online by credit assignment: each earns a rank-based reward only for minima that are new to an archive of all minima seen so far and is chosen with probability proportional to its forgotten reward per ionic step, so the search behaves like a GA, a basin hopping or a random search depending on which currently pays off. A second (meta-Lamarckian) credit level selects the BH move: adaptive shake, twist, rigid move, lattice strain, unlike-atom swap (best of 4 trial swaps by unrelaxed energy) or relocation of the highest-energy atoms to the best-bonded of 48 candidate sites, which on supports and in pores include sites next to host atoms so that atoms can wet the support. Fingerprint niching and elitist immigration after stagnation keep the population diverse.

自适应模因算法：一个小规模、带小生境的已弛豫结构种群（仅以两个随机结构起步，其余由子代填充）由三种相互竞争的算子演化：Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接交叉（表面体系保持吸附位点配准）或晶格遗传（体相）；从优良且尚未“耗尽”的个体出发、可自行终止的短程 Metropolis 盆地跳跃链；以及新的随机结构，其中一半在成键良好的位点上逐原子生长得到。离子步预算通过信用分配在线分给各算子：只有产生“已见极小值档案”中没有的新极小值时，算子才获得基于排名的奖励，并按其带遗忘的“每离子步奖励”成比例地被选中，因此搜索会根据当前哪种策略更有效而表现为遗传算法、盆地跳跃或随机搜索。第二层（元拉马克式）信用分配选择盆地跳跃的移动类型：自适应扰动、扭转、刚性移动、晶格应变、异种原子交换（4 次试交换中取未弛豫能量最低者），或把能量最高的原子迁移到 48 个候选位点中成键最好的位置——在载体上或孔道内，候选位点也包括基底原子旁的位置，使原子可以铺展到载体上。指纹小生境和停滞后的精英保留式移民维持种群多样性。
algs.ref: P. Moscato, Caltech C3P Report 826 (1989); Y.-S. Ong & A. J. Keane, IEEE Trans. Evol. Comput. 8, 99 (2004); D. M. Deaven & K. M. Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); A. R. Oganov & C. W. Glass, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 244704 (2006); D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997)

algs.name: Adaptive operator selection basin hopping
desc: Basin hopping in which an online multi-armed bandit chooses every move from a category-aware portfolio of structure operators: global and local rattles, relocation of the least-bound atoms (ranked by NEP per-atom energies) to the most coordinated free sites or, for supported clusters, to apex sites on top of the cluster (turning wetting 2D rafts into 3D islands), cluster twists, rigid moves on the support or in the pore, unlike-atom swaps, cell strains, cut-and-splice with archived minima and fresh random structures. The bandit (discounted Thompson sampling with per-move ionic-step costs) credits each operator with success per ionic step (new best minimum, novel low-lying minimum, downhill hop), so effort shifts automatically to the moves that pay off on each system without per-benchmark tuning. Move amplitudes and the Metropolis temperature adapt online, relaxations that cannot reach Metropolis range are aborted early with a calibrated energy-tail predictor, and stagnating walkers restart from random or perturbed archived structures.

在基跳（basin hopping）框架中，由在线多臂老虎机算法为每一步从一组按体系类别配置的结构算子中选择移动方式：全局与局部随机扰动、将结合最弱的原子（按 NEP 原子能量排序）迁移到配位最高的空位，对负载团簇还可迁移到团簇顶部的顶位（把润湿载体的二维筏状结构变为三维岛）、团簇扭转、载体或孔道中团簇的刚体移动、异种原子交换、晶胞应变、与存档低能结构的切割拼接以及全新的随机结构。该老虎机（带折扣并计入离子步代价的 Thompson 采样）按每个离子步的成功率（新的全局最优、新的低能极小、下坡跳跃）为各算子记功，从而无需针对具体体系调参即可自动把计算量转向在当前体系上有效的移动。移动幅度与 Metropolis 温度在线自适应；利用经校准的能量尾部预测器提前终止无法进入 Metropolis 接受范围的弛豫；搜索停滞时从随机结构或扰动后的存档极小重新开始。
algs.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Fialho, Da Costa, Schoenauer & Sebag, Ann. Math. Artif. Intell. 60, 25 (2010); Thierens, GECCO 2005, 1539; Xia et al., IJCAI 2015; Raj & Kalyani, arXiv:1707.09727 (2017); Deaven & Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); Rondina & Da Silva, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 53, 2282 (2013)

algs.name: Soft-mode guided hopping
desc: Basin hopping whose trial moves follow the softest collective vibrational modes of the current minimum instead of random displacements of all atoms. The modes cost no energy evaluations: they come from a bond-stiffness model Hessian built from covalent radii (exponential pair springs; substrate atoms act as anchors and bulk crystals include the six cell-strain components), and the same model Hessian preconditions the L-BFGS relaxations. The jump amplitude adapts online so that 65% of jumps escape into a new basin, alloys add unlike-atom swaps with a self-tuned probability, and Metropolis acceptance with restarts after stagnation is kept from basin hopping. New is the use of free model-Hessian soft modes, instead of the costly true-Hessian softening of USPEX softmutation or minima hopping, together with escape-rate control and model-Hessian preconditioning.

一种盆地跳跃（basin hopping）方法：试探步不再随机扰动所有原子，而是沿当前极小结构最软的集体振动模式移动。这些模式不消耗任何能量计算：它们来自由共价半径构建的键刚度模型 Hessian（指数型原子对弹簧；衬底原子作为锚点，体相晶体额外包含六个晶胞应变分量），同一模型 Hessian 还用作 L-BFGS 局部弛豫的预条件子。跳跃幅度在线自适应，使 65% 的跳跃逃逸到新的盆地；合金体系额外使用概率自调节的异种原子交换，并保留盆地跳跃的 Metropolis 接受准则和停滞后从随机结构重启。其新颖之处在于：使用零代价的模型 Hessian 软模（代替 USPEX 软模突变或极小跳跃中代价高昂的真实 Hessian 软化），并结合逃逸率控制和模型 Hessian 预条件。
algs.ref: A. O. Lyakhov, A. R. Oganov & M. Valle, Comput. Phys. Commun. 181, 1623 (2010) [softmutation]; M. Schoenborn, S. Goedecker, S. Roy & A. R. Oganov, J. Chem. Phys. 130, 144108 (2009) [minima-hopping softening]; G. Henkelman & H. Jonsson, J. Chem. Phys. 111, 7010 (1999) [dimer]; R. Lindh et al., Chem. Phys. Lett. 241, 423 (1995) [model Hessian]; D. Packwood et al., J. Chem. Phys. 144, 164109 (2016) [preconditioning]; A. R. Atilgan et al., Biophys. J. 80, 505 (2001) [anisotropic network model]; D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]

algs.name: Genetic algorithm (cut-and-splice)
desc: Faithful baseline implementation, with literature parameter values, of the standard Lamarckian cluster genetic algorithm (Deaven-Ho / Birmingham Cluster GA / ASE-GA): a population of 20 locally relaxed structures evolves in steady state, with parents chosen by roulette-wheel selection on Johnston's tanh fitness of the normalised energy (plus the ASE-GA pairing and duplicate history penalties). Children are made by Deaven-Ho cut-and-splice crossover (a vertical cut for supported clusters with registry-preserving alignment; for bulk the Abraham-Probert periodic cut in fractional coordinates with lattice heredity) or, with probability 0.2, by standard mutations (rattle, mirror, twist, atom relocation, permutation of unlike atoms; cell strain for bulk). Every child is relaxed with L-BFGS and replaces the worst member if it is lower and not a duplicate (energy + fingerprint); after 10 generations' worth of candidates (200) without a new best structure, the GA restarts from a new random population.

标准拉马克式团簇遗传算法（Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接、伯明翰团簇遗传算法 BCGA 与 ASE-GA）的忠实基线实现，采用文献标准参数：由 20 个经局部弛豫的结构组成的种群以稳态方式进化，父代通过轮盘赌选择，适应度为 Johnston 的归一化能量 tanh 函数（并带有 ASE-GA 的配对次数与重复结构惩罚）。子代由 Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接交叉产生（负载团簇采用垂直于表面的切面并保持吸附位点对齐；体相采用 Abraham-Probert 在分数坐标下的周期性切割并继承加权平均的晶格），或以 0.2 的概率由标准变异产生（随机扰动、镜像、半团簇扭转、原子重定位、异种原子置换；体相另有晶胞应变）。每个子代都用 L-BFGS 局部弛豫，若能量低于种群中最差个体且不与已有结构重复（能量加指纹判据）则将其替换；若连续 10 代（200 个候选结构）未找到更优结构，则以新的随机种群重新开始。
algs.ref: D. M. Deaven & K. M. Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); R. L. Johnston, Dalton Trans. 2003, 4193 (Birmingham Cluster GA); L. B. Vilhelmsen & B. Hammer, J. Chem. Phys. 141, 044711 (2014) (ASE-GA); N. L. Abraham & M. I. J. Probert, Phys. Rev. B 73, 224104 (2006) (periodic cut for crystals)

algs.name: Tabu basin hopping
desc: Basin hopping steered by a tabu memory of every local minimum it has found (energy-binned hash plus a species-resolved distance fingerprint, so recognising a minimum costs no extra force calls). Minima are accepted by a Metropolis test on E + lambda*log(1+visits) with a short recency tabu list; falling back into a known minimum enlarges the next perturbation, repeated revisits trigger restarts from random structures or rarely used low-energy archive minima, and relaxations that are about to end in a stored minimum are stopped early. Cluster moves relocate the atoms with the highest per-atom NEP energy to the surface; what is new is that one memory steers acceptance, step size, restarts and relaxation cost at once (tabu search + energy-landscape paving + minima-hopping-style feedback).

由禁忌记忆引导的盆地跳跃（basin hopping）：算法记录已找到的每一个局部极小（按能量分箱的哈希加按元素区分的距离指纹，识别极小无需额外的力计算）。对 E + λ·log(1+访问次数) 做 Metropolis 接受判据并配合短期禁忌表；落回已知极小时增大下一次扰动，反复重访则从随机结构或很少使用的低能存档极小重新开始，即将收敛到已知极小的弛豫会被提前终止。团簇移动按每原子 NEP 能量把结合最弱的原子重新放到表面；新颖之处在于同一份记忆同时控制接受、步长、重启和弛豫成本（禁忌搜索 + 能量景观铺平 + 极小跳跃式反馈）。
algs.ref: Glover, ORSA J. Comput. 1, 190 (1989) and 2, 4 (1990) [tabu search]; Cvijovic & Klinowski, Science 267, 664 (1995) [taboo search for continuous global optimisation]; Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Hansmann & Wille, Phys. Rev. Lett. 88, 068105 (2002) [energy landscape paving]; Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 9911 (2004) [history feedback of minima hopping]; Garivier & Moulines, ALT 2011, LNCS 6925, 174 [discounted UCB bandits]; Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004) and Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) [surface relocation of high-energy atoms]

algs.name: Symmetry-seeded search
desc: Two-armed search whose exploration arm generates random but symmetric starting structures with self-written group-theory code: gas-phase clusters get a random point group whose orbits (centre, rotation axes, mirror planes, general positions) are filled by a knapsack partition of the exact composition, supported clusters a vertical Cn/Cnv group centred on a top, bridge or hollow site, zeolite guests symmetric motifs inside the pore, and bulk crystals Wyckoff orbits of 37 space groups with a random supercell; for alloys and ionic compositions symmetric 'skeletons' are decorated with species by core-shell, random or electronegativity-contrast rules. The exploitation arm is a Metropolis basin-hopping walker (adaptive steps, cell strain, unlike-atom swaps and, for clusters, a move that projects the structure onto its detected approximate point group) that jumps to better seeds and restarts on stagnation. Discounted probability-matching bandits split the effort between seeding and hopping, and among symmetric, C1 and plain random seeds, by the rate of new low-lying minima per ionic step. New is the combination of AIRSS/PyXtal/CALYPSO-style symmetric random seeding, in one code for clusters, supported clusters, zeolite guests and crystals, with bandit-balanced basin hopping, plus the skeleton decoration and the symmetrise move.

对称性播种搜索包含两个分支。探索分支用自编的群论代码生成随机但具有对称性的初始结构：气相团簇随机选取点群，并以精确组成的背包划分填充其各类轨道（中心、旋转轴、镜面与一般位置）；负载团簇采用以顶位、桥位或空位为轴心的竖直 Cn/Cnv 点群；分子筛客体团簇在孔道内放置对称结构单元；体相晶体填充 37 个空间群的 Wyckoff 轨道并随机扩胞；对合金和离子型组成，先生成对称“骨架”，再按核壳、随机或电负性差最大化规则分配元素。利用分支是 Metropolis 基跳行走者（自适应步长、晶胞应变、异种原子交换，以及对团簇将结构投影到其检测出的近似点群的“对称化”移动），遇到更优的种子结构时跳转过去，停滞时从新种子重启。带折扣的概率匹配老虎机按每个离子步获得新低能极小的速率，在播种与跳跃之间、以及对称、C1 与普通随机种子之间分配计算量。创新之处在于把 AIRSS/PyXtal/CALYPSO 式的对称随机播种在同一套代码中统一用于团簇、负载团簇、分子筛客体与晶体，并与老虎机平衡的基跳相结合，另加骨架装饰与对称化移动。
algs.ref: C. J. Pickard & R. J. Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011) (AIRSS); S. Fredericks, K. Parrish, D. Sayre & Q. Zhu, Comput. Phys. Commun. 261, 107810 (2021) (PyXtal); Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu & Y. Ma, Phys. Rev. B 82, 094116 (2010) and Comput. Phys. Commun. 183, 2063 (2012) (CALYPSO); D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping)

algs.name: Particle swarm optimisation (CALYPSO)
desc: CALYPSO-style particle swarm optimisation: a swarm of 20-30 locally relaxed structures moves by the PSO velocity update towards each particle's personal best and the best of its nearest neighbours in fingerprint space (local PSO, inertia weight decreasing from 0.9 to 0.4, c1 = c2 = 2, velocity clamping), while 40% of every generation are fresh random structures. As in CALYPSO, random crystals are built with space-group symmetry and random gas-phase clusters with point-group symmetry, near-duplicate structures are removed by a fingerprint similarity check, and the swarm restarts after 10 generations without a better global best. The only addition is an alignment step for permutable atoms (per-species Hungarian assignment, plus Kabsch rotation for free clusters) before every velocity update.

CALYPSO 风格的粒子群优化：由 20-30 个局部弛豫结构组成的粒子群按 PSO 速度更新公式移动，趋向每个粒子的个体最优和其在指纹空间中最近邻粒子的最优结构（局部 PSO，惯性权重由 0.9 线性降至 0.4，c1 = c2 = 2，速度限幅），每一代另有 40% 为新的随机结构。与 CALYPSO 一致，随机晶体按空间群对称性生成，随机气相团簇按点群对称性生成，借助指纹相似性判据剔除近似重复的结构，连续 10 代全局最优不再改进时重启粒子群。唯一的补充是针对可置换原子的对齐步骤：每次速度更新前按元素做匈牙利算法匹配，自由团簇还额外做 Kabsch 旋转对齐。
algs.ref: Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, Phys. Rev. B 82, 094116 (2010); Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, Comput. Phys. Commun. 183, 2063 (2012); J. Lv, Y. Wang, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, J. Chem. Phys. 137, 084104 (2012); Y. Wang et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 27, 203203 (2015)

algs.name: USPEX evolutionary algorithm
desc: Generational evolutionary algorithm in the style of USPEX: a population of 10-30 locally relaxed structures (2 x number of search atoms) evolves by spatial heredity (~50%; a random plane or crystal slab cuts two fitness-ranked parents and their halves are combined, with a weighted-average lattice for crystals), new random structures (~20%), soft mutation along the softest vibrational mode of a bond-hardness spring model (~20%), swaps of unlike atoms (multi-element systems) and random lattice strain (bulk). The best 60% of the distinct structures are parents and the best 15% are kept unchanged; duplicates are removed with Oganov-Valle fingerprints (crystals) or distance fingerprints (clusters). This is a standard baseline that uses the USPEX default operator mix and parameter values. The search restarts when the best structure has not improved for n_search generations.

USPEX 风格的代际进化算法：由 10-30 个（搜索原子数的 2 倍）经局部弛豫的结构组成种群，通过以下算子产生下一代：空间遗传（约 50%，用随机平面或晶体切片切分两个按能量排序选出的父代并拼接，晶体的晶格取两者的随机加权平均）、随机新结构（约 20%）、沿键硬度弹簧模型最软振动模式的软模突变（约 20%）、不同元素原子交换（多元素体系）以及随机晶格应变（体相）。不重复结构中能量最低的 60% 作为父代，最好的 15% 直接保留到下一代；晶体用 Oganov-Valle 指纹、团簇用距离指纹剔除重复结构。这是采用 USPEX 默认算子比例和参数值的标准基线方法。若最优结构连续 n_search 代没有改进，搜索重新开始。
algs.ref: A. R. Oganov & C. W. Glass, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 244704 (2006); A. O. Lyakhov, A. R. Oganov, H. T. Stokes & Q. Zhu, Comput. Phys. Commun. 184, 1172 (2013); A. O. Lyakhov, A. R. Oganov & M. Valle, Comput. Phys. Commun. 181, 1623 (2010); A. O. Lyakhov & A. R. Oganov, Phys. Rev. B 84, 092103 (2011); A. R. Oganov & M. Valle, J. Chem. Phys. 130, 104504 (2009); Q. Zhu, L. Li, A. R. Oganov & P. B. Allen, Phys. Rev. B 87, 195317 (2013)

algs.name: Energy-guided basin hopping
desc: Energy-guided basin hopping (EGBH) is a basin-hopping walk whose moves are steered by the per-atom energies that NEP89 returns for free with every evaluation. Weakly bound atoms (high site energy relative to their own species) are moved preferentially to dynamic-lattice candidate sites (apex sites above bonded triangles, bridge and atop sites of the cluster, support or crystal) that are ranked by an online, element-resolved site-energy model learned from the potential's own energy decomposition; alloys and compounds also get model-guided swaps and an exchange scan that ranks all swaps of the current minimum by their single-point energies. Tabu lists, energy-weighted shakes, twists, rigid and strain moves and fresh random structures diversify the search, and the move probabilities adapt online to each move's energy gain per ionic step. New compared with standard basin hopping and dynamic lattice searching is that the ML potential's site energies decide both which atoms to move and, via the learned model, where atoms of each element want to sit.

能量引导盆地跳跃（EGBH）是一种盆地跳跃随机游走，其移动由 NEP89 每次计算时免费给出的单原子能量引导。弱束缚原子（位点能量相对于同种元素偏高）被优先移动到动态晶格候选位点（团簇、载体或晶体上键合三角形上方的顶点位、桥位和顶位），这些位点由一个在线学习、按元素区分的位点能量模型排序，该模型直接从势函数自身的能量分解中学习；合金和化合物还使用模型引导的异种原子交换，以及用单点能量对当前极小结构的所有交换进行排序的交换扫描。禁忌表、能量加权扰动、扭转、刚体移动、晶胞应变和全新随机结构保证搜索的多样性，各类移动的概率根据其每个离子步带来的能量收益在线自适应调整。与标准盆地跳跃和动态晶格搜索相比，其创新之处在于用机器学习势的位点能量同时决定移动哪些原子，并通过所学模型判断每种元素的原子倾向于占据哪些位置。
algs.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004) [dynamic lattice searching]; Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) [moving the highest-energy atoms to the best surface sites]; Rossi & Ferrando, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 21, 084208 (2009) [exchange moves for nanoalloys]; Behler & Parrinello, PRL 98, 146401 (2007) [atom-centred radial descriptors]; Glover, ORSA J. Comput. 1, 190 (1989) [tabu search]

algs.name: Racing basin hopping
desc: Basin hopping in which every local relaxation races against the Metropolis acceptance threshold: the Metropolis random number is drawn before relaxing, and the L-BFGS relaxation is advanced one iteration at a time. It is abandoned as soon as an optimistic lower bound of its final energy shows that the trial will be rejected anyway, and it stops at a loose force threshold when the trial is surely accepted but cannot become a new global best. The bound is calibrated online by conformal prediction, separately for random restarts and for local moves, on a random 10% of trials that are relaxed in full, which keeps the probability of a wrong abort at or below 10% for any energy scale. The steps saved on losing trials pay for bold moves: cut-and-regrow of high-energy atoms at well-coordinated sites, swaps, rigid moves of supported clusters and raced random restarts.

一种盆地跳跃（basin hopping）方法，其中每一次局部弛豫都与 Metropolis 接受阈值进行“竞速”：Metropolis 判据所用的随机数在弛豫开始之前就已抽取，L-BFGS 弛豫则逐步推进、每次只走一步迭代。一旦最终能量的乐观下界表明该试探无论如何都会被拒绝，弛豫就立即中止；如果试探必然被接受、但不可能成为新的全局最优，则在较宽松的力收敛阈值处提前停止。该下界通过保形预测（conformal prediction）在线校准，随机重启与局部移动各自单独校准：随机抽取 10% 的试探做完整弛豫作为校准样本，因此无论体系的能量尺度如何，错误中止的概率都不超过 10%。在必败试探上节省下来的步数被用于更大胆的移动：在高配位空位处“切除再生长”高能原子、交换不同元素原子、对负载团簇做刚性平移转动，以及参与竞速的随机重启。
algs.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Maron & Moore, NIPS 6 (1994) and Artif. Intell. Rev. 11, 193 (1997); Jamieson & Talwalkar, AISTATS (2016); Li et al., JMLR 18, 1 (2018); Vovk, Gammerman & Shafer, Algorithmic Learning in a Random World, Springer (2005); Iwamatsu & Okabe, Chem. Phys. Lett. 399, 396 (2004); Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004)

algs.name: Differential evolution
desc: Classic DE/rand/1/bin (Storn & Price) on a population of 20 locally relaxed structures (Lamarckian, as in the cluster code PDECO): for every target a mutant a + F(b - c) (F = 0.5) is built from three other random members, binomially crossed with the target atom by atom (CR = 0.9; for bulk the cell is one extra gene), relaxed, and it replaces the target only if it is lower in energy and not a duplicate of another member. Because atoms are permutable, the parents are first aligned per species by Hungarian assignment, plus Kabsch rotation for gas-phase clusters, lattice translations for supported and zeolite clusters, and canonical reduced cells with fractional coordinates for bulk. It is a standard baseline: the only additions are this alignment, duplicate rejection and the constraint repair needed for atoms.

经典的 DE/rand/1/bin 差分进化（Storn & Price），种群由 20 个经过局部弛豫的结构组成（拉马克式，与团簇优化程序 PDECO 相同）：对每个目标个体，用另外三个随机个体构造变异向量 a + F(b - c)（F = 0.5），再以原子为单位与目标个体做二项交叉（CR = 0.9；体相晶体的晶胞作为额外一个基因），弛豫后只有当能量更低且与其他个体不重复时才替换目标个体。由于同种原子可以互换，构造差分向量前先按元素用匈牙利算法匹配原子；气相团簇另做 Kabsch 旋转对齐，负载团簇和分子筛内团簇只做晶格平移，体相则使用约化晶胞中的分数坐标。这是一个标准基线方法，只为原子体系补充了对齐、去重和约束修复。
algs.ref: R. Storn & K. Price, J. Glob. Optim. 11, 341 (1997); Z. Chen, X. Jiang, J. Li, S. Li & L. Wang, J. Comput. Chem. 34, 1046 (2013) (PDECO); Y.-Y. Zhang, W. Gao, S. Chen, H. Xiang & X.-G. Gong, Comput. Mater. Sci. 98, 51 (2015) (IM2ODE)

algs.name: Cut-and-regrow (learned-site growth)
desc: A Metropolis walk over relaxed minima whose only structural move is cut-and-regrow: k atoms are removed (those with the highest NEP per-atom energy, a random contiguous fragment, or the least-coordinated ones) and regrown one by one at geometrically enumerated hollow, bridge and atop sites on the remaining cluster, the support or zeolite wall, or inside the periodic cell (bulk: plus cell strain; alloys/compounds: plus energy-guided species swaps). What is new: the sites are ranked by a per-species ridge model of NEP per-atom energies that is refitted on the fly from relaxation start and end points at no extra ionic steps; the cut size grows adaptively on stagnation up to about n/3 before a random restart; and each local relaxation is two-stage, finished to full accuracy only if the trial can still pass the pre-drawn Metropolis threshold.

在弛豫后的局部极小之间进行 Metropolis 随机行走，唯一的结构移动是“切除-再生长”：先移除 k 个原子（NEP 单原子能量最高的原子、随机的空间连续片段或配位数最低的原子），再将它们逐个重新生长到几何枚举的空位（三原子穴位、桥位、顶位）上——位置可以在剩余团簇上、载体或分子筛孔壁上，或在周期性晶胞内（体相同时施加随机晶胞应变；合金/化合物另加按能量引导的元素交换）。创新之处：候选位点由一个按元素区分的岭回归模型排序，该模型拟合 NEP 单原子能量，并利用每次弛豫起点和终点的数据在线更新，不消耗额外离子步；停滞时切除数 k 自适应增大至约 n/3，之后随机重启；每次局部弛豫分两阶段进行，只有当试探结构仍可能通过预先抽取的 Metropolis 阈值时才弛豫到完全收敛。
algs.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping); Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 11401 (2004) (dynamic lattice searching); Rondina & Da Silva, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 53, 2282 (2013) (revised basin hopping); Deaven & Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995) (cut-and-splice); Northby, J. Chem. Phys. 87, 6166 (1987) and Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) (cluster growth sequences); Pickard & Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011) (AIRSS random restarts)

algs.name: Basin hopping
desc: Monte Carlo minimisation (basin hopping) with the standard GMIN settings: a Metropolis walk at kT = 0.1 eV on the relaxed energy surface. Every move displaces all search atoms uniformly within a sphere of radius step (bulk: plus a random symmetric cell strain, σ = 0.05), relaxes with L-BFGS and accepts with probability min(1, exp(−ΔE/kT)). Every 10 moves the step is multiplied by 1.1 or 0.9 depending on whether the acceptance ratio of those 10 moves is above 50% (bounded to 0.1–2 Å, initial 0.5 Å); detached cluster atoms are re-seated on the cluster surface. Literature parameters, not tuned.

采用 GMIN 标准设置的蒙特卡洛极小化（盆地跳跃）：在弛豫后的能量面上进行 kT = 0.1 eV 的 Metropolis 行走。每次移动把所有搜索原子在半径为 step 的球内均匀随机位移（体相再加 σ = 0.05 的随机对称晶胞应变），用 L-BFGS 弛豫，并以 min(1, exp(−ΔE/kT)) 的概率接受。每 10 次移动根据这 10 次移动的接受率是否高于 50% 将步长乘以 1.1 或 0.9（限制在 0.1–2 Å，初值 0.5 Å）；团簇中脱离的原子被重新放回团簇表面。采用文献参数，未调参。
algs.ref: Li & Scheraga, PNAS 84, 6611 (1987); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997)

algs.name: Artificial bee colony (ABCluster)
desc: Swarm-intelligence search over a population of SN=10 locally relaxed structures (food sources). In every cycle, employed bees create one neighbour per source by moving a random subset of atoms (bulk: also the lattice) along the difference to another, aligned source, v = x_i + phi (x_i - x_k) with phi in [-1,1], relax it and keep it only if it is lower in energy; onlooker bees repeat this on sources drawn with probability proportional to fitness, and scout bees replace sources that have not improved for limit=3 cycles with new random relaxed structures. This is the standard method of Karaboga & Basturk as adapted to clusters in ABCluster; the only additions are per-species Hungarian/Procrustes alignment before differencing, fractional-coordinate plus lattice-vector moves for variable-cell bulk, and re-seating of supported-cluster atoms that a move carries across the periodic vacuum towards the underside of the slab.

人工蜂群算法：以 SN=10 个经局部弛豫的结构作为“蜜源”进行群体智能搜索。每一轮中，雇佣蜂为每个蜜源生成一个邻域解：将随机选取的一部分原子（体相还包括晶格）沿该蜜源与另一个经过对齐的蜜源之差移动，v = x_i + φ(x_i − x_k)，φ∈[−1,1]，局部弛豫后仅当能量更低时才替换原蜜源；观察蜂按适应度成比例地选择蜜源重复该操作；侦察蜂把连续 limit=3 轮未改进的蜜源替换为新的随机弛豫结构。这是 Karaboga 与 Basturk 提出、并由 ABCluster 推广到团簇的标准方法；此处仅增加了差分前按元素的匈牙利/Procrustes 结构对齐、可变晶胞体相中对分数坐标和晶格矢量的同时操作，以及把被移动穿过周期性真空层、移向基底下表面的负载团簇原子重新放回团簇上。
algs.ref: D. Karaboga & B. Basturk, J. Glob. Optim. 39, 459 (2007); J. Zhang & M. Dolg, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 17, 24173 (2015) (ABCluster)

algs.name: Metadynamics-biased basin hopping
desc: Basin hopping whose Metropolis test uses E + V(s) instead of E: s is an energy-agnostic structural descriptor of each local minimum (coordination numbers per element pair, Steinhardt q4/q6, size and shape of clusters, substrate contacts and height of supported clusters, volume per atom of crystals) and V is a well-tempered metadynamics bias made of broad Gaussians (each covering a whole funnel of similar minima) deposited at the visited minima, so structural regions where the walker has lingered are gradually filled and it is pushed towards unexplored structure types, while the true NEP energy alone defines the best structure. Moves combine random displacements with an adaptive step, relocation of high per-atom-energy atoms to well-coordinated hollow sites, unlike-atom swaps, rigid moves of supported or confined clusters and occasional random-structure jumps; trial relaxations stop early once an online-calibrated estimate of the remaining energy drop shows that they cannot pass the pre-drawn Metropolis threshold. What is new is the history-dependent bias over collective variables, borrowed from free-energy metadynamics, applied to the discrete walk between minima of basin hopping.

在盆地跳跃（basin hopping）的 Metropolis 判据中用 E + V(s) 代替 E：s 是每个局部极小结构的与能量无关的结构描述符（按元素对的配位数、Steinhardt q4/q6、团簇的尺寸与形状、负载团簇与基底的接触及高度、晶体的每原子体积），V 是在已访问极小处沉积宽高斯函数（每个覆盖由相似极小构成的整个漏斗）构成的 well-tempered 元动力学偏置势，从而逐步填平游走者长时间停留的结构区域，把它推向尚未探索的结构类型，而最优结构仍只由真实的 NEP 能量决定。移动包括步长自适应的随机位移、把单原子能量高的原子移到配位良好的空位（hollow site）、异种原子交换、负载或限域团簇的刚性移动以及偶尔的随机结构跳跃；当在线标定的剩余能量下降估计表明某次试探弛豫已不可能通过预先抽取的 Metropolis 阈值时，提前终止该弛豫。创新之处在于把自由能计算中作用于集体变量的元动力学历史依赖偏置引入到盆地跳跃在极小之间的离散游走中。
algs.ref: Laio & Parrinello, PNAS 99, 12562 (2002); Barducci, Bussi & Parrinello, PRL 100, 020603 (2008); Iwamatsu & Okabe, Chem. Phys. Lett. 399, 396 (2004); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Steinhardt, Nelson & Ronchetti, PRB 28, 784 (1983); cf. energy-landscape paving, Hansmann & Wille, PRL 88, 068105 (2002)

algs.name: Stochastic surface walking
desc: Metropolis Monte Carlo walk between local minima in which every trial move is a smooth climb out of the current basin: Gaussian bias potentials (width 0.6 Å, up to 10 per move) are added one after another along a random direction that a biased dimer rotation softens towards low-curvature modes, the structure is relaxed on the biased surface after each addition, and finally all biases are removed and the structure is fully relaxed and accepted or rejected at 1000 K. Standard SSW of Shang & Liu with literature parameters (crystals: atoms and lattice in one generalised coordinate set as in LASP); every force call of the dimer rotations, the climb and the relaxations counts as an ionic step.

在局域极小之间进行 Metropolis 蒙特卡洛行走，每一次试探移动都从当前势阱中平滑地“爬出”：沿一个随机方向（用偏置二聚体旋转向低曲率的软模修正）逐个加入高斯偏置势（宽度 0.6 Å，每步最多 10 个），每加一个就在偏置势能面上做局域弛豫，最后去掉全部偏置势并完全弛豫到新的极小，再按 1000 K 的 Metropolis 准则接受或拒绝。这是采用文献参数的标准 SSW 方法（Shang 和 Liu），晶体按 LASP 的方式把原子和晶格自由度放在同一组广义坐标中；二聚体旋转、爬坡和弛豫中的每一次力计算都计为一个离子步。
algs.ref: C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 9, 1838 (2013) (SSW); C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 2215 (2012) (BP-CBD biased dimer rotation/translation); X.-J. Zhang, C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 9, 3252 (2013); C. Shang, X.-J. Zhang, Z.-P. Liu, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 16, 17845 (2014) (SSW-crystal); S.-D. Huang, C. Shang, P.-L. Kang, X.-J. Zhang, Z.-P. Liu, WIREs Comput. Mol. Sci. 9, e1415 (2019) (LASP)

algs.name: Minima hopping
desc: Minima hopping (Goedecker 2004): from the current local minimum a short molecular-dynamics run with Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities at temperature T crosses a barrier, is stopped at the second potential-energy minimum along the trajectory and is relaxed with L-BFGS; T is raised (x1.1) when the walker falls back into the same or an already visited minimum and lowered (/1.1) when a new minimum is found, and every different minimum is accepted if its energy is less than Ediff above the current one, with Ediff self-adjusting (x0.98 on acceptance, /0.98 on rejection) so that about half of them are accepted. As in the later versions of the Goedecker group, the initial velocities are first softened towards low-curvature directions with up to 20 gradient-only dimer iterations (Schoenborn et al. 2009), the MD time step adapts to energy conservation, and bulk crystals use variable-cell escape dynamics in which the lattice vectors move as well (Amsler & Goedecker 2010), followed by a variable-cell relaxation and Minkowski reduction of the cell. It is a faithful baseline with the ASE / literature default parameters (T0 = 1000 K, Ediff0 = 0.5 eV, mdmin = 2); only safety measures were added: escapes that break energy conservation or squash the cell are stopped early and counted as too hot (T is lowered), and atoms that detach from a cluster or adsorbate are put back before the relaxation.

极小跳跃法（Goedecker 2004）：从当前局部极小出发，以温度 T 下的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼速度进行一段短的分子动力学模拟以越过势垒，在轨迹上遇到第二个势能极小时停止，再用 L-BFGS 弛豫；若落回同一个或已访问过的极小则升高 T（×1.1），找到新极小则降低 T（÷1.1）；与当前不同的极小只要能量比当前高出不到 Ediff 就被接受，Ediff 自适应调整（接受时 ×0.98，拒绝时 ÷0.98），使大约一半的极小被接受。与 Goedecker 课题组后来的版本一样，初始速度先经过最多 20 次只用梯度的二聚体迭代向低曲率方向软化（Schönborn 等 2009），MD 时间步长根据能量守恒情况自适应调整；体相晶体采用晶格矢量也随之运动的可变晶胞逃逸动力学（Amsler & Goedecker 2010），随后进行可变晶胞弛豫并对晶胞做 Minkowski 约化。这是采用 ASE/文献默认参数（T0 = 1000 K、Ediff0 = 0.5 eV、mdmin = 2）的忠实基线实现，仅加入了安全措施：破坏能量守恒或把晶胞压扁的逃逸会被提前终止并视为过热（降低 T），脱离团簇或吸附物的原子在弛豫前被放回原处。
algs.ref: S. Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 9911 (2004) (minima hopping); S. E. Schoenborn, S. Goedecker, S. Roy & A. R. Oganov, J. Chem. Phys. 130, 144108 (2009) (softening); M. Amsler & S. Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 133, 224104 (2010) (variable-cell minima hopping); A. A. Peterson, Top. Catal. 57, 40 (2014) (ASE MinimaHopping, default parameters); M. Krummenacher et al., SoftwareX 25, 101632 (2024) (minimahopping reference code: time-step feedback, softening details)

algs.name: Parallel-tempering basin hopping
desc: Basin-hopping parallel tempering (BHPT, also called replica-exchange basin hopping): six standard basin-hopping walkers (the move set, L-BFGS quench and adaptive step size of the BH baseline) run at temperatures on a fixed geometric ladder kT = 0.05-0.5 eV, share one ionic-step budget and take one BH step each in turn. After every round, with probability 0.5, neighbouring temperatures swap their current minima with the replica-exchange criterion min(1, exp[(1/kT_i - 1/kT_j)(E_i - E_j)]), so that low-lying minima found by the hot, freely exploring walkers migrate down to the cold walkers, which refine them. This is the standard method of Strodel et al. (GMIN keyword BHPT) with literature parameter values; the only changes are the serial interleaving of the replicas on a single budget, a per-temperature step size adapted from the acceptance of the last 10 moves, and, for variable-cell bulk, Minkowski reduction of the lattice before each cell-strain move and restarting a replica whose cell relaxation aborted.

基于并行回火的盆地跳跃（BHPT，又称副本交换盆地跳跃）：六个标准盆地跳跃行走者（与 BH 基线相同的移动方式、L-BFGS 局部弛豫和自适应步长）分别处于 kT = 0.05–0.5 eV 的固定几何温度阶梯上，共享同一个离子步预算，轮流各走一步。每轮结束后以 0.5 的概率让相邻温度的副本按副本交换判据 min(1, exp[(1/kT_i − 1/kT_j)(E_i − E_j)]) 交换各自当前的局部极小，使高温副本自由探索时发现的低能极小逐步传递到低温副本中进一步精修。这是 Strodel 等人提出的标准方法（GMIN 关键字 BHPT），采用文献中的参数值；唯一的改动是各副本在单进程中交替运行并共享预算、每个温度的步长根据最近 10 次移动的接受率自适应调整，以及对变胞体相在每次晶胞应变移动前做 Minkowski 晶格约化、并在晶胞弛豫中止时让该副本从新的随机结构重新开始。
algs.ref: Strodel, Lee, Whittleston & Wales, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 132, 13300 (2010) (basin-hopping parallel tempering, GMIN keyword BHPT); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping); Swendsen & Wang, Phys. Rev. Lett. 57, 2607 (1986) and Hukushima & Nemoto, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 65, 1604 (1996) (replica exchange / parallel tempering)

algs.name: Random search
desc: Ab initio random structure searching (AIRSS) style sampling: independent random structures (with a random cell for bulk crystals) are generated inside the search region with the shared minimum-distance and connectivity constraints, and each is relaxed with L-BFGS. There is no memory between trials, so its efficiency is the probability of landing in the global-minimum basin per ionic step; it is the reference for how much a search strategy gains over pure sampling.
仿照 AIRSS（从头随机结构搜索）的随机采样：在搜索区域内按统一的最小原子间距与连通性约束独立生成随机结构（体相同时随机生成晶胞），每个结构用 L-BFGS 弛豫。各次试验之间没有记忆，因此其效率就是每个离子步落入全局最优盆地的概率；它是衡量搜索策略相对纯随机采样收益的参照。
algs.ref: Pickard & Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011)

algs.name: Simulated annealing (MD)
desc: Classic simulated annealing carried out with molecular dynamics: every cycle starts from a fresh random structure, heats it to 2500 K with a Langevin thermostat and cools it geometrically to 300 K over 3000 MD steps (2 fs time step, shorter for light elements), then quenches it to the nearest local minimum with L-BFGS; independent cycles are repeated until the budget is spent. Bulk crystals are annealed at zero pressure with a Berendsen barostat and quenched with a variable-cell relaxation. Nothing is new: it is a faithful baseline with standard literature parameters; only safety measures were added (an elastic container that pulls evaporated fragments back to the cluster, a speed cap against MD explosions) and the last anneal is shortened to fit the remaining budget.

经典的分子动力学模拟退火：每个循环从一个新的随机结构出发，用朗之万恒温器加热到 2500 K，并在 3000 个 MD 步内（时间步长 2 fs，轻元素相应缩短）按几何级数降温到 300 K，随后用 L-BFGS 淬火到最近的局部极小；各循环相互独立，重复进行直到预算用完。体相晶体在零压下用 Berendsen 恒压器退火，并以可变晶胞弛豫淬火。该方法没有新的改动，是采用文献标准参数的忠实基线实现；仅加入了安全措施（把蒸发出去的碎片拉回团簇的弹性容器、防止 MD 发散的速度上限），并把最后一次退火缩短以适应剩余预算。
algs.ref: S. Kirkpatrick, C. D. Gelatt & M. P. Vecchi, Science 220, 671 (1983); R. Biswas & D. R. Hamann, Phys. Rev. B 34, 895 (1986) (MD annealing of Si clusters); H. J. C. Berendsen et al., J. Chem. Phys. 81, 3684 (1984) (barostat); B. Leimkuhler & C. Matthews, Appl. Math. Res. Express 2013, 34 (BAOAB Langevin integrator)

benches.name: cl_Ag27Cu7
benches.title: Ag27Cu7 nanoalloy
benches.description: Gas-phase Ag27Cu7 nanoalloy (geometry plus homotop / chemical-ordering search). With the Gupta potential the GM is a perfect core-shell polyicosahedron (pIh7, D5h) with a Cu7 pentagonal-bipyramid core under a 27-atom Ag shell (Rossi et al., PRL 93, 105503 (2004)); NEP89 reproduces this structure.

benches.name: cl_Ag55
benches.title: Ag55 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Ag55. The Mackay icosahedron is the GM for many-body potentials (Cambridge Cluster Database) and is supported by DFT and photoelectron spectra of Ag55- (Haekkinen et al., PRL 93, 093401 (2004)). NEP89 reproduces it, about 2 eV below the cuboctahedron and Ino decahedron; the difficulty is the size of the landscape rather than near-degenerate competitors.

benches.name: cl_Al8O12
benches.title: (Al2O3)4 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase (Al2O3)4, an alumina dust-nucleation and gas-phase IR target; DFT global minima of small (Al2O3)n are compact cages of 4-membered Al2O2 and 6-membered Al3O3 rings with 3-5-fold Al and 2-4-fold O (Rahane, Deshpande & Kumar, JPCC 115, 18111 (2011)), and for n = 4 the B3LYP GM is a low-symmetry (C1) cage while PBE0 prefers a D3d isomer (Gobrecht et al., A&A 658, A167 (2022)). The NEP89 putative GM has these features (Cs cage; five 3-fold and three 4-fold Al; ten 2-fold, one 3-fold and one 4-fold O; two Al2O2 and eight Al3O3 rings; Al-O 1.71-1.98 A; no O-O or Al-Al bonds), but its identity with the DFT GM was not verified. A Cs isomer 0.20 eV higher (one 2-fold Al) forms a competing funnel that traps some basin-hopping runs. Artefact screening: NEP89 has an O-O bonded hole; a particle-swarm run found a cage with O-O 1.11 and 1.22 A, Al-O 1.53 A and only 5-fold Al, 0.08 eV below the physical minimum. An O-O guard floor of 1.9 A (guard_pairs; the shortest physical O-O distance here is 2.49 A) lifts it by 41 eV and leaves the physical minima unchanged.

benches.name: cl_Au20
benches.title: Au20 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Au20. DFT and photoelectron spectroscopy give a tetrahedral (Td) pyramid, a 20-atom fcc fragment (Li, Li, Zhai & Wang, Science 299, 864 (2003)). NEP89 instead prefers a low-symmetry structure with one interior atom; the relaxed Td pyramid is 0.11 eV higher.

benches.name: cl_B12
benches.title: B12 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase B12. Photoelectron spectroscopy and ab initio calculations establish a quasi-planar C3v global minimum (Zhai et al., Nat. Mater. 2, 827 (2003)), with 3D isomers such as the icosahedron several eV higher. NEP89 reverses this ordering: its putative GM is the Ih icosahedron (B-B 1.73 A, the building block of bulk boron), 2.7 eV below the relaxed quasi-planar C3v structure, so this benchmark probes search on the NEP89 landscape rather than boron-cluster chemistry.

benches.name: cl_Cu38
benches.title: Cu38 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Cu38. For many-body potentials (Gupta, Sutton-Chen) the GM is the Oh fcc truncated octahedron, separated from icosahedral/decahedral structures as in the LJ38 double funnel (Doye & Wales, New J. Chem. 22, 733 (1998); Cambridge Cluster Database). NEP89 agrees; the best non-fcc structure found lies 0.11 eV higher.

benches.name: cl_Mg8O8
benches.title: (MgO)8 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase (MgO)8. IR spectroscopy combined with DFT global optimisation (Haertelt et al., PCCP 14, 2849 (2012)) assigns cage-like structures containing hexagonal (MgO)3 rings, not rocksalt cuboids, to (MgO)n with n != 3k. NEP89 instead favours rocksalt fragments: its putative GM (a 3x3x2 rocksalt slab missing one corner MgO pair; Mg 3-5-fold coordinated, Mg-O 1.94-2.31 A, no O-O or Mg-Mg bonds) lies 0.25 eV below the 2x2x4 cuboid and 2.7 eV below a hand-built hexagonal-ring cage.

benches.name: cl_Na8Cl8
benches.title: (NaCl)8 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase (NaCl)8. Small alkali-halide clusters adopt rocksalt-cuboid structures in ab initio and Tosi-Fumi studies (Aguado et al., PRB 56, 15353 (1997); Doye & Wales, PRB 59, 2292 (1999)), and the NEP89 putative GM is the 2x2x4 rocksalt cuboid (Na-Cl 2.56-2.65 A). The landscape is soft: fmax = 0.05 relaxations of the same GM differ by up to 0.016 eV (0.3 meV after tight relaxation), hence e_tol = 0.05 eV.

benches.name: cl_Pt13
benches.title: Pt13 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Pt13.

benches.name: cl_Pt19
benches.title: Pt19 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Pt19. PBE and hybrid DFT give a Pt18 three-layer trigonal prism capped on a triangular face (C3v; Kumar & Kawazoe, PRB 77, 205418 (2008); J. Mol. Model. (2024), doi:10.1007/s00894-024-06099-5). NEP89 instead prefers a hollow 19-vertex deltahedral cage (all atoms 5- or 6-coordinated, Pt-Pt 2.53-2.57 A), 1.5 eV below the relaxed DFT structure and 0.66 eV below the fcc octahedron, so this landscape is NEP89-specific.

benches.name: cl_Pt7Cu6
benches.title: Pt7Cu6 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase bimetallic Pt7Cu6 nanoalloy (13 atoms): geometric and homotop (chemical ordering) search.

benches.name: cl_Si20
benches.title: Si20 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase Si20. Ion-mobility measurements and DFT show prolate Si_n clusters built from stacked tricapped-trigonal-prism units up to n ~ 25, with compact isomers close in energy around n = 20 (Ho et al., Nature 392, 582 (1998)). NEP89 has two near-degenerate putative minima, a compact oblate GM and a prolate isomer only 2 meV higher (tight relaxation), both with 4-7-fold coordinated Si and Si-Si >= 2.41 A, so a hit (E <= E_best + e_tol) can be either isomer.

benches.name: cl_Ti6O12
benches.title: (TiO2)6 cluster
benches.description: Gas-phase (TiO2)6, a standard titania-nanocluster global-optimisation target; DFT global minima of small (TiO2)n are compact, with 4-/5-fold coordinated Ti and one or two terminal Ti=O groups (Qu & Kroes, JPCB 110, 8998 (2006); Lamiel-Garcia et al., Nanoscale 9, 1049 (2017)). The NEP89 putative GM has these features (two titanyl O at 1.69 A, four 4- and two 5-fold Ti, nine 4-membered Ti2O2 rings, no O-O bonds), but its identity with the DFT GM was not verified; the default repulsive guard (Ti-O r0 = 1.695 A) is marginally active on the titanyl bonds (0.3 meV).

benches.name: su_Au8_MgO100
benches.title: Au8 / MgO(001)
benches.description: Au8 on a frozen 3-layer MgO(001) slab (6x6 primitive surface cells, 216 atoms; NEP89 a = 4.203 A vs exp. 4.212 A), the classic model of size-selected Au_n/MgO catalysts (Ricci et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 036106 (2006)). The NEP89 putative GM is a flat Au8 island with all 8 Au in contact with the surface (Au-Au 2.74-2.83 A); NEP89 puts single Au atoms on top of O as DFT does, but places the best 3D isomers found (fcc 6+2 bilayers) >= 0.69 eV above the flat GM, whereas DFT finds 3D Au8 on bulk MgO(001) and planar Au8 only on metal-supported MgO films that charge the cluster (Ricci et al. 2006), i.e. NEP89 over-stabilises wetting. e_tol is 0.015 eV because distinct flat isomers lie 0.019 eV above the GM.

benches.name: su_Au8_TiO2_110
benches.title: Au8 / rutile TiO2(110)
benches.description: Au8 on a frozen 3-trilayer stoichiometric rutile TiO2(110) slab (3x6 cell, 19.5 x 17.7 A, 324 atoms; NEP89 a = 4.606 A, c = 2.957 A vs exp. 4.594, 2.959 A), the model support of Au/TiO2 CO-oxidation catalysts (Valden, Lai and Goodman, Science 281, 1647 (1998)). The NEP89 putative GM is a compact 3D Au8 with 5 Au in contact, 3 on the bridging-O row (Au-O 2.20 A) and 2 atop 5-fold Ti in the trough (Au-Ti 2.68 A); DFT likewise finds small Au_n turning 3D on stoichiometric TiO2(110) (Au7) but binds them mainly through bridging and in-plane O (Chretien and Metiu, J. Chem. Phys. 127, 084704 (2007)), whereas NEP89 also favours Au-Ti5c contacts (a single Au sits atop Ti5c). The stoichiometric frozen slab lacks the O vacancies that anchor Au in experiment.

benches.name: su_Cu8_TiC001
benches.title: Cu8 / TiC(001)
benches.description: Cu8 on a frozen 4-layer TiC(001) slab (5x5 primitive cells, 200 atoms; NEP89 a = 4.285 A vs exp. 4.328 A), a model of Cu/TiC(001) catalysts for CO2 hydrogenation to methanol (Vidal et al., J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 3, 2275 (2012)). The NEP89 putative GM is a flat Cu8 island with every Cu on a top-C site (Cu-C 1.95 A), the adatom site found by DFT (Gomez et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 114, 1622 (2010)); DFT places the 2D-to-3D crossover at Cu7 and finds a Cu6+2 bilayer for Cu8 (Li et al., ACS Omega 6, 27259 (2021)), which NEP89 puts 0.55 eV above its flat GM, i.e. NEP89 over-stabilises wetting.

benches.name: su_Pd10_Au111
benches.title: Pd10 / Au(111)
benches.description: Pd10 on a frozen 4-layer Au(111) slab (7x7, 196 Au; NEP89 a(Au) = 4.111 A vs exp. 4.078 A), a model of Pd-Au bimetallic catalysts and PdAu(111) surface alloys (Maroun et al., Science 293, 1811 (2001); Chen et al., Science 310, 291 (2005)). The NEP89 putative GM is a flat Pd10 island with every Pd in an fcc hollow (the same island in hcp hollows is 0.24 eV higher), in line with the 2D close-packed Pd islands seen by STM on Au(111) (Casari et al., Phys. Rev. B 79, 195402 (2009)); the frozen substrate excludes the Pd-Au place exchange (surface alloying) observed at room temperature.

benches.name: su_Pd16_graphene
benches.title: Pd16 / graphene
benches.description: Pd16 on frozen graphene (8x8, 128 C; NEP89 a = 2.476 A vs exp. 2.461 A), a model of graphene-supported Pd catalysts; DFT finds Pd clusters on graphene to be 3D from Pd4 on, because Pd-Pd bonding dominates the weak Pd-graphene interaction (Cabria et al., Phys. Rev. B 81, 035403 (2010)). The NEP89 putative GM is a Pd13 icosahedron with three capping atoms that touches graphene with a single vertex atom above a C6 hollow (Pd-C 2.39 A); other capping isomers and orientations lie within 0.031 eV (next family +0.074 eV) and runs that reached the GM structure differ by up to 0.024 eV, hence e_tol = 0.05 eV.

benches.name: su_Pt10_CeO2_111
benches.title: Pt10 / CeO2(111)
benches.description: Pt10 on a frozen O-terminated CeO2(111) slab (3 O-Ce-O trilayers, 5x5 cell, 225 atoms; NEP89 a = 5.438 A vs exp. 5.411 A), a model of Pt/ceria oxidation and three-way catalysts. The NEP89 putative GM is a 3D Pt7+3 bilayer bound to surface O (Pt-O 1.99 A), and NEP89 Pt8 is planar, in line with the DFT 2D-to-3D transition above Pt8 for Pt_N on CeO2(111) (Paz-Borbon et al., Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 19, 17845 (2017)). NEP89 is charge-neutral: the Pt-to-ceria electron transfer and Ce4+ -> Ce3+ reduction found by DFT are not described, and the frozen slab excludes O spillover and vacancy formation.

benches.name: su_Pt10_TiO2a101
benches.title: Pt10 / anatase TiO2(101)
benches.description: Pt10 on a frozen 3-layer stoichiometric anatase TiO2(101) slab (oblique 15.2 x 15.3 A cell, 216 atoms; NEP89 a = 3.819 A, c = 9.296 A vs exp. 3.785, 9.514 A), the majority facet of anatase-supported Pt photo- and thermal catalysts. The NEP89 putative GM is a 3D Pt5+5 bilayer anchored on the terrace by 5-fold Ti (Pt-Ti 2.49-2.65 A) and 2-fold O (Pt-O 2.09 A), consistent with the strong Pt binding on anatase(101) terraces found by DFT and STM (Gong et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 130, 370 (2008)). Caveats: NEP89 Pt-Ti contacts are short (2.76 A in Pt3Ti), NEP89 is charge-neutral and its anatase c axis is 2.3% too short.

benches.name: su_Pt4Sn4_Al2O3
benches.title: Pt4Sn4 / alpha-Al2O3(0001)
benches.description: Pt4Sn4 on a frozen Al-terminated alpha-Al2O3(0001) slab ((2sqrt3 x 2sqrt3)R30, Al96O144; NEP89 a/c = 4.753/12.895 A vs exp. 4.759/12.991 A), a model of Pt-Sn/Al2O3 propane-dehydrogenation catalysts (sub-nanometre Pt and PtSn clusters on alumina: Baxter et al., ACS Catal. 7, 3322 (2017); Liu et al., ACS Catal. 13, 2802 (2023)). In the NEP89 putative GM the oxophilic Sn atoms bind surface O (Sn-O 2.37-2.55 A) and carry the Pt atoms on top (only Pt-Sn and Pt-Pt bonds, no Sn-Sn); note that NEP89 relaxes the surface Al 0.4 A below the top O plane (DFT: about 0.1 A above).

benches.name: su_Pt8_MgO100
benches.title: Pt8 / MgO(001)
benches.description: Pt8 cluster on a frozen 4-layer MgO(001) slab (3x3 conventional cells, 144 atoms).

benches.name: su_Pt8_MoS2
benches.title: Pt8 / MoS2 monolayer
benches.description: Pt8 on a frozen 1H-MoS2 monolayer (6x6, 108 atoms; NEP89 a = 3.150 A vs exp. 3.160 A), a model of Pt/MoS2 catalysts; DFT finds that Pt_n clusters on the MoS2 basal plane become 3D from n = 5 and that Pt particles bind to S (Saidi, Cryst. Growth Des. 15, 642 (2015)). The NEP89 putative GM is a 3D 5+3 Pt bilayer whose five lower Pt sit above Mo atoms, each bonded to three S (Pt-S 2.31-2.35 A, Pt-Pt 2.58-2.60 A); the lowest competing isomer, a 4+4 bilayer, is 0.16 eV higher.

benches.name: su_Pt8_SrTiO3_100
benches.title: Pt8 / SrTiO3(001)
benches.description: Pt8 on a frozen TiO2-terminated SrTiO3(001) slab (SrO/TiO2/SrO/TiO2, 4x4 cell, 160 atoms; NEP89 a = 3.908 A vs exp. 3.905 A), a model of Pt/SrTiO3 photocatalysts and perovskite-supported Pt. The NEP89 putative GM is a single buckled Pt8 layer (6 Pt on the surface, Pt-O 2.19 A, Pt-Ti 2.61 A; 2 Pt 1.7 A higher), in line with DFT, which finds the TiO2 termination favourable for epitaxial Pt(100) films (Asthagiri and Sholl, J. Chem. Phys. 116, 9914 (2002)). NEP89 is charge-neutral and the frozen, unreconstructed slab excludes the surface reconstructions and O vacancies of real SrTiO3(001).

benches.name: ze_Au6_MFI
benches.title: Au6 @ MFI (channel intersection)
benches.description: Au6 cluster at the intersection of the straight and sinusoidal 10-ring channels of a frozen all-silica MFI framework (silicalite-1; NEP89-relaxed orthorhombic cell, 288 framework atoms). Metal clusters encapsulated in MFI resist sintering (Goel, Zones and Iglesia, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 15280 (2014)); for Au clusters in zeolites see Otto, Zones and Iglesia, J. Catal. 339, 195 (2016). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: buckled Au6 anchored to the intersection wall); Au replaces Pd because NEP89 bonds Pd and Pt atoms to SiO4 edges of MFI (M-Si 2.4-2.5 A).

benches.name: ze_Au7_BEA
benches.title: Au7 @ BEA (channel intersection)
benches.description: Au7 cluster at an intersection of the 12-ring channels of a frozen all-silica zeolite beta (polymorph A; NEP89-relaxed tetragonal cell, 192 framework atoms). Metal clusters immobilised inside beta crystals resist sintering (Wang et al., Nat. Catal. 1, 540 (2018)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: planar Au7 spanning the intersection).

benches.name: ze_Cu6_AEI
benches.title: Cu6 @ AEI
benches.description: Cu6 cluster in the pear-shaped aei cage (8-ring windows, 3.8 A) of a frozen all-silica AEI (SSZ-39) framework (NEP89-relaxed conventional cell, 144 atoms); Cu-SSZ-39 is a hydrothermally stable NH3-SCR deNOx catalyst (Moliner et al., Chem. Commun. 48, 8264 (2012)) in which Cu can agglomerate into clusters. Framework Al, ionic/oxidic Cu and framework relaxation are not modelled, NEP89 binds Cu atoms to the cage wall (Cu-O ~2.1 A, Cu-Si ~2.4 A) and places this framework 6.7 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz (calorimetry: all-silica zeolites lie ~7-14 kJ/mol above), so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum.

benches.name: ze_Pt4_CHA
benches.title: Pt4 @ CHA
benches.description: Pt4 cluster inside the cha cage of a frozen all-silica chabazite framework (hexagonal cell, 108 atoms).

benches.name: ze_Pt6_TON
benches.title: Pt6 @ TON
benches.description: Pt6 cluster in the one-dimensional 10-ring channel (4.6 x 5.7 A) of a frozen all-silica TON (ZSM-22/Theta-1) framework (NEP89-relaxed from a symmetry-broken start, 1x1x3 supercell, 216 atoms; density within 0.3 % of Theta-1); Pt/ZSM-22 is the classic shape-selective n-alkane hydroisomerisation catalyst (Martens and co-workers). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent, NEP89 binds Pt to siloxane O (Pt-O ~2.2 A) and places this framework 3.6 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz, so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum (Pt is used because NEP89 spuriously embeds Ir/Rh atoms into silica walls).

benches.name: ze_Pt8_FAU
benches.title: Pt8 @ FAU (supercage)
benches.description: Pt8 cluster in the supercage (~11.2 A) of a frozen all-silica faujasite (siliceous Y; NEP89-relaxed rhombohedral primitive cell, 144 framework atoms). Pt clusters in the supercages of Y zeolite are the classic encapsulated noble-metal catalyst (Gallezot et al., J. Catal. 39, 334 (1975)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: flat Pt8 anchored to the wall by four Pt-O).

benches.name: ze_Pt8_MWW
benches.title: Pt8 @ MWW
benches.description: Pt8 cluster in the 12-ring supercage (7.1 x 18.2 A, 10-ring windows) of a frozen all-silica MWW (MCM-22/ITQ-1) framework (NEP89-relaxed hexagonal cell, 216 atoms); subnanometric Pt clusters encapsulated in MCM-22 cavities are sinter-resistant, size-selective catalysts (Liu et al., Nat. Mater. 16, 132 (2017)). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent, NEP89 places this framework 0.8 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz and attracts Pt to the cage wall by ~0.7 eV/atom even at Pt-O distances > 3 A, so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum.

benches.name: ze_Pt9_LTA
benches.title: Pt9 @ LTA (alpha cage)
benches.description: Pt9 cluster in the alpha cage (11.4 A) of a frozen all-silica LTA framework (ITQ-29; NEP89-relaxed, fcc-type 2x supercell, 144 framework atoms). Pt, Pd and Rh clusters encapsulated in LTA were prepared by Choi, Wu and Iglesia (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 132, 9129 (2010)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: planar Pt9 lying flat on the cage wall).

benches.name: ze_Pt9_MOR
benches.title: Pt9 @ MOR
benches.description: Pt9 cluster in the 12-ring main channel (6.5 x 7.0 A, with 8-ring side pockets) of a frozen all-silica mordenite framework (NEP89-relaxed 1x1x2 primitive supercell, 144 atoms); Pt/H-mordenite is the industrial light-naphtha isomerisation catalyst (Shell Hysomer process). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent and NEP89 binds Pt to siloxane O atoms (Pt-O ~2.0 A), so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum (Pt is used because NEP89 spuriously embeds Rh/Ir atoms into silica walls).

benches.name: bu_Al8O12
benches.title: Al2O3 (Al8O12) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of Al2O3 with 4 formula units (20 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state corundum (alpha-Al2O3, R-3c; this cell is twice its rhombohedral primitive cell) is also the NEP89 global minimum; theta-Al2O3 (beta-Ga2O3 type, mixed tetrahedral/octahedral Al, +36 meV/atom with NEP89) is a deep competing funnel.

benches.name: bu_Ca2C2O6
benches.title: CaCO3 (Ca2C2O6) crystal
benches.description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of CaCO3 with two formula units (10 atoms) per cell: planar CO3 anions must assemble from random atoms. Experimental ground state: calcite (R-3c, 10-atom primitive cell); aragonite and vaterite are metastable. NEP89 caveats: the putative NEP89 global minimum is a vaterite-like layered polymorph (CO3 planes normal to the Ca layers, +6% volume) 7.4 meV/atom below calcite, and CaO + CO2 is only 0.32 eV/f.u. above calcite (exp. ~1.8 eV), a frequent trap.

benches.name: bu_Ga6N6
benches.title: GaN (Ga6N6) crystal
benches.description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of GaN with six formula units (12 atoms) per cell. Experimental ground state: wurtzite (P6_3mc); zinc blende (~10 meV/atom higher in DFT), the 6H polytype and the high-pressure rocksalt phase compete. NEP89 caveat: NEP89 puts zinc blende 33 meV/atom below wurtzite (wrong polytype ordering), so its global minimum is zinc blende. Artefact screening: NEP89 has an N-N bonded collapsed hole (N-N 1.17 A, Ga-Ga 2.02 A, 12-fold Ga, 2.7 eV below zinc blende), found by symmetry-constrained random search. An N-N guard floor of 1.9 A (guard_pairs; physical N-N >= 3.1 A) lifts it by 46 eV and leaves the physical minima unchanged.

benches.name: bu_Ga8O12
benches.title: Ga2O3 (Ga8O12) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of Ga2O3 with 4 formula units (20 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state beta-Ga2O3 (C2/m, half tetrahedral and half octahedral Ga; this cell is twice its primitive cell) is also the NEP89 global minimum; corundum-type alpha-Ga2O3 (+28.7 meV/atom with NEP89) is a deep competing funnel (the mirror image of bu_Al8O12, where corundum is the ground state and the beta-Ga2O3 type is the trap).

benches.name: bu_Mg2Al4O8
benches.title: MgAl2O4 spinel (Mg2Al4O8) crystal
benches.description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the spinel MgAl2O4 with two formula units (14 atoms, the fcc primitive cell of spinel) per cell. Experimental ground state: normal spinel (Fd-3m; Mg tetrahedral, Al octahedral); inverse cation orderings and MgO + Al2O3 (corundum) compete. NEP89 caveat: the inverse spinel (Al tetrahedral, Mg + Al octahedral) is 62 meV/atom below normal spinel, which is even 49 meV/atom above MgO + Al2O3, so the NEP89 global minimum is the inverse spinel.

benches.name: bu_Mg4Cu8
benches.title: MgCu2 (Mg4Cu8) Laves-phase crystal
benches.description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the Laves phase MgCu2 with four formula units (12 atoms) per cell: a size-mismatched, topologically close-packed intermetallic. Experimental ground state: cubic C15 (Fd-3m); the hexagonal C14 (MgZn2-type) polytype and AlB2/MoSi2-type AB2 structures compete. NEP89 reproduces C15 as the global minimum, but C14 is only 0.5 meV/atom higher (within e_tol, so it also counts as a hit).

benches.name: bu_Si4O8
benches.title: SiO2 (Si4O8) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of SiO2 with 4 formula units (12 atoms) per cell, which fits alpha-cristobalite, tridymite and stishovite but not the experimental ground state alpha-quartz (Z=3; 29.6 meV/atom above the GM with NEP89). NEP89 over-stabilises open corner-sharing SiO4 frameworks (alpha-cristobalite 24.5 meV/atom below quartz): the putative NEP89 global minimum is an all-silica ABW zeolite framework (coordination sequence 4,10,21,36,54,...; 17.3 A^3/atom, 23% less dense than quartz), 5.1 meV/atom below alpha-cristobalite. NEP89 also has an unphysical hole with over-short Si=O bonds (1.30 A) and Si-Si bonds that lies 0.12 eV below this minimum; a Si-O guard floor of 1.45 A removes it (physical Si-O bonds are >= 1.5 A).

benches.name: bu_Si6N8
benches.title: Si3N4 (Si6N8) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of Si3N4 with 2 formula units (14 atoms) per cell, the primitive cell of both the experimental ground state beta-Si3N4 (P6_3/m) and spinel gamma-Si3N4. The putative NEP89 global minimum is not beta-Si3N4 but a hypothetical, chemically sensible network (tetrahedral Si, 3-coordinated but pyramidal N, no homopolar bonds) 12 meV/atom below beta-Si3N4 and 7% denser. Artefact screening: NEP89 has two collapsed holes, an N-N bonded phase (N-N 1.10-1.14 A, Si-Si 1.97 A, 28.5 eV below the physical minimum) and a dense phase with Si-Si 1.65 A (5.2 eV below), both found by symmetry-constrained random search. Guard factor 0.90 (Si-Si >= 2.0 A, Si-N >= 1.64 A) plus an N-N floor of 1.9 A remove both (re-relaxed >= 8.7 eV above the minimum); the physical minima (Si-N >= 1.68 A, N-N >= 2.7 A) are unchanged.

benches.name: bu_Si8
benches.title: Si8 crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction, 8 Si atoms per cell.

benches.name: bu_Sr4Ti4O12
benches.title: SrTiO3 (Sr4Ti4O12) crystal
benches.description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the perovskite SrTiO3 with four formula units (20 atoms) per cell, enough for octahedral tilt systems (a0a0c-, I4/mcm: the experimental low-temperature phase; cubic Pm-3m above 105 K; a-b+a- Pnma as in CaTiO3); ilmenite and hexagonal-perovskite arrangements compete. In NEP89 tilts gain < 1 meV/atom, so cubic and tilted perovskites are nearly degenerate. guard_factor 0.80: NEP89 has a short-range Sr-O hole (with the default 0.75 an unphysical Sr2Ti2O6 structure with Sr-O = 1.93 A was 0.046 eV below the perovskite).

benches.name: bu_Ti4O8
benches.title: TiO2 (Ti4O8) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of TiO2 with 4 formula units per cell (rutile, anatase, brookite-like and high-pressure polymorphs compete). guard_factor 0.80: with the default guard (0.75) NEP89 has a dense collapsed phase (about 5.5 A^3/atom, Ti-Ti 2.21 A, O-O 1.2 A, 12-18 neighbours per Ti) about 1 eV below anatase; the stronger guard (Ti-Ti >= 2.56 A, Ti-O >= 1.81 A) removes it and is zero for rutile, anatase and brookite.

benches.name: bu_Zn12O12
benches.title: ZnO (Zn12O12) crystal
benches.description: Crystal structure prediction of ZnO with 12 formula units (24 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state wurtzite (P6_3mc) is also the NEP89 global minimum; the nearly degenerate tetrahedral stacking polytypes (4H +5, zinc blende +7 meV/atom) and rocksalt (+47 meV/atom) are competing minima.

notes:
Notes on interpretation

  • Runs and cost. “50 runs” means 50 independent random seeds per algorithm and benchmark, each with the full ionic-step budget of the benchmark. Efficiency is measured per ionic step (one NEP89 energy+force evaluation of the whole system), not per second; a wall-clock score is given separately. Every run used one CPU core of a 5-node (640-core) NERSC Perlmutter allocation.
  • Development/test split. The six development benchmarks (marked *) were used to develop and tune the new algorithms and are excluded from the headline score. Developers also ran short crash tests (one seed) on all benchmarks, and the developer of the adaptive memetic algorithm ran a 5-seed smoke test on held-out benchmarks; these runs checked robustness only, but we disclose them as a possible minor leak of test information.
  • NEP89 is not DFT. The reference structures are putative global minima of the NEP89 surface (among structures in which the guard is inactive), and several differ from DFT or experiment. We keep them, because the benchmark measures search efficiency on a fixed surface: Si8 (β-tin-like cell below diamond), GaN (zinc blende 33 meV/atom below wurtzite), SiO2 (an ABW-type framework below α-cristobalite and quartz), Si3N4 (a hypothetical network 12 meV/atom below β-Si3N4), CaCO3 (vaterite-like layers 7 meV/atom below calcite), MgAl2O4 (inverse spinel), TiO2 (anatase 66 meV/atom below rutile), Au20 (a low-symmetry isomer instead of the Td pyramid), Pt19 (a hollow cage), B12 (icosahedron instead of the quasi-planar cluster), (MgO)8 (a rocksalt fragment instead of ring cages), and over-wetting of Au8/MgO(001) and Cu8/TiC(001). The benchmark descriptions give the details.
  • Supported and confined clusters. Substrates are frozen slabs or frameworks. NEP89 is charge-neutral and was not fitted to metal/oxide or metal/zeolite interfaces, so binding energies and site preferences are qualitative. NEP89 bonds Pd and Pt atoms to the SiO4 edges of MFI (M–Si 2.4–2.5 Å), so Au clusters are used in MFI.
  • Tolerance. etol = 0.02 eV except ze_Pt6_TON, ze_Pt8_MWW and ze_Pt9_LTA (0.01 eV) and su_Au8_MgO100 (0.015 eV), where distinct isomers lie closer than 0.02 eV, and cl_Na8Cl8 and su_Pd16_graphene (0.05 eV), where runs that reach the same structure scatter by more than 0.02 eV.
  • Artefact screening. See Methods: extra guard settings were applied to six benchmarks after dedicated hole-hunting runs, the surface benchmarks got a vacuum wall that keeps the search atoms on the top face of the slab (binding to the frozen bottom face of the periodic image was 1.4 eV too favourable for Au8/TiO2(110)), and after the main experiment every rank-1 structure was re-checked (recomputed energy, shortest distances, guard and wall energy, connectivity, density) and the guard and wall energy of every structure that counts as a hit was computed. This found NEP89 holes that the guard makes shallower but does not remove in two held-out crystals, SiO2 and SrTiO3 (20 of the 49,500 runs ended in them). Eref is therefore taken from structures in which the guard is inactive, and the ranking does not change if these 20 runs are counted as failures (Methods). Runs made before a guard setting of a benchmark was changed carry a different benchmark hash and are not used for Eref. The vacuum wall did not change the hashes: it is exactly zero for every stored slab structure, and the two development runs that had ended on the far side of the vacuum were removed.
  • Wall-time cap. The two surrogate-model algorithms (GOFEE and SurrBH) spend most of their time on training their surrogate models and relaxing on them, so their runs were capped at 1 h of wall time. A capped run that had not hit the global minimum is charged the full step budget, so that a slow algorithm does not look cheaper per ionic step; a hit before the cap counts normally. 1,960 of the 2,250 GOFEE runs reached the cap (1,500 of them after a hit, 460 without one); no SurrBH run did. SurrBH also scales its surrogate work to the elapsed wall time so that a run fits in the cap, so its runs are not bit-for-bit reproducible on other hardware. All other algorithms ran without a time limit.
  • Shared code. All algorithms use the same evaluation context, relaxers and structure operators. Before the main experiment the context was changed to start cell relaxations from a Minkowski-reduced lattice when the cell basis has become very skewed (this removed spurious aborted relaxations in bulk searches), and basin hopping now adapts its step from the acceptance ratio of the last 10 moves, as in GMIN. Two robustness fixes change nothing in normal runs: an evaluation on which NEP89 fails (neighbour-list overflow in a collapsed cell) is counted as one ionic step with a very high energy instead of aborting the run, and the shared relocation operator falls back to the unchanged structure when no site can be found. Known simplifications kept because the algorithms were tuned with them: the shared cut-and-splice operator (used by GOFEE, AOS-BH and SurrBH) recentres the second parent onto the first in 3D, which moves supported-cluster atoms off their adsorption sites (GA uses its own operator), the shared relocation operator puts atoms only on the outer shell of a supported cluster (never directly on the support), and the Maxwell–Boltzmann velocity helper removes the unweighted mean velocity rather than the centre-of-mass velocity.

解读说明

  • 运行次数与成本。“50 轮”指每个算法在每个基准上用 50 个独立随机种子各运行一次，每次运行都使用该基准的完整离子步预算。 效率按离子步（对整个体系做一次 NEP89 能量+力计算）而不是按秒计算；另外单独给出按墙钟时间的得分。每次运行占用 NERSC Perlmutter 上 5 个节点（640 核）中的一个 CPU 核。
  • 开发集与测试集。6 个开发基准（标 *）用于开发和调试新算法，不计入主得分。开发者还在所有基准上做过简短的崩溃测试（1 个种子）， 自适应模因算法的开发者在留出基准上做过 5 个种子的冒烟测试；这些运行只用于检查稳健性，但我们仍将其披露为可能的轻微测试信息泄漏。
  • NEP89 不等于 DFT。参考结构是 NEP89 势能面上（guard 不起作用的结构中）的推定全局最优，其中若干与 DFT 或实验不同。由于本基准衡量的是在给定势能面上的 搜索效率，我们保留这些结构：Si8（β-tin 型晶胞低于金刚石结构）、GaN（闪锌矿比纤锌矿低 33 meV/原子）、SiO2 （ABW 型骨架低于 α-方石英和石英）、Si3N4（一种假想网络比 β-Si3N4 低 12 meV/原子）、 CaCO3（球霰石型层状结构比方解石低 7 meV/原子）、MgAl2O4（反尖晶石）、TiO2（锐钛矿比金红石低 66 meV/原子）、Au20（低对称异构体而非 Td 四面体）、Pt19（空心笼）、B12（二十面体而非准平面结构）、 (MgO)8（岩盐碎片而非环状笼）、以及 Au8/MgO(001) 与 Cu8/TiC(001) 的过度铺展。详见各基准说明。
  • 负载与受限团簇。衬底为冻结的平板或骨架。NEP89 不含电荷转移，也未针对金属/氧化物或金属/分子筛界面拟合，因此结合能与位点偏好 只具有定性意义。NEP89 会使 Pd、Pt 原子与 MFI 的 SiO4 棱成键（M–Si 2.4–2.5 Å），所以 MFI 中改用 Au 团簇。
  • 容差。etol 一般为 0.02 eV；ze_Pt6_TON、ze_Pt8_MWW、ze_Pt9_LTA 为 0.01 eV，su_Au8_MgO100 为 0.015 eV（不同异构体 间距小于 0.02 eV）；cl_Na8Cl8 与 su_Pd16_graphene 为 0.05 eV（到达同一结构的运行能量分散超过 0.02 eV）。
  • 伪影筛查。见方法部分：经专门的“空洞”搜寻后，对 6 个基准加强了 guard 设置；表面基准增加了真空势墙，使搜索原子 留在平板顶面（对 Au8/TiO2(110)，吸附到周期镜像冻结底面的结构能量偏低 1.4 eV）；主实验结束后对每个排名第一的结构 重新检查（重算能量、最短距离、guard 与势墙能量、连通性、密度），并计算了所有计为命中的结构的 guard 与势墙能量。由此在两个留出晶体 SiO2 与 SrTiO3 中发现了 guard 只使其变浅、但没有消除的 NEP89 空洞（49,500 次运行中有 20 次停在其中）。因此 Eref 取自 guard 不起作用的结构；把这 20 次运行计为失败也不改变排名（见方法）。基准的 guard 设置修改之前的运行带有不同的基准哈希，不用于确定 Eref。 真空势墙没有改变基准哈希：它对所有已保存的表面结构严格为零，两个最终停在真空层另一侧的开发运行已被移除。
  • 墙钟时间上限。两个代理模型算法（GOFEE 与 SurrBH）的大部分时间花在代理模型的训练和在代理模型上的弛豫上，因此每次运行限时 1 小时； 达到上限前未命中的运行按全部预算计入步数，以免慢速算法在每离子步效率上显得更便宜；在上限前命中的运行照常计为命中。GOFEE 的 2,250 次运行中有 1,960 次达到上限（其中 1,500 次在此之前已命中，460 次未命中）；SurrBH 没有运行达到上限。SurrBH 还会根据已用墙钟时间调整代理模型的工作量以便在上限内完成，因此其运行在其他硬件上 不能逐位复现。其余算法的运行不设时间上限。
  • 共享代码。所有算法使用同一个计算上下文、弛豫器与结构操作。主实验前对上下文做了修改：当晶胞基矢严重倾斜时，晶胞弛豫从 Minkowski 约化后的晶格开始（消除了体相搜索中虚假的弛豫中止）；盆地跳跃改为按最近 10 次移动的接受率调整步长（与 GMIN 一致）。 两项稳健性修正不影响正常运行：NEP89 计算失败（塌缩晶胞中近邻表溢出）时，该次计算记为一个能量极高的离子步而不再中止运行； 共享的原子重定位操作在找不到位置时返回原结构。以下简化因各算法已据此调参而保留：共享的 cut-and-splice 交叉算子（GOFEE、AOS-BH 与 SurrBH 使用）把第二个亲本在三维上平移到第一个亲本的 中心，这会使负载团簇的原子偏离吸附位点（GA 使用自己的算子）；共享的原子重定位操作只把原子放到负载团簇的外壳上（不会直接放到衬底上）；Maxwell–Boltzmann 速度函数去除的是未加权的平均速度而不是质心速度。
